title: Crispy Rice Salad
description: A Chef Aly Thermomix reinterpretation of Hetty McKinnon-style crispy rice salad: crunchy rice, bright herbs, sesame dressing and exact TM6 and TM7 settings.
keywords: Hetty McKinnon crispy rice salad Thermomix
intro: This is the kind of salad that eats like a proper meal: warm crispy rice, cool herbs, crunchy vegetables and a savoury sesame-lime dressing. The Thermomix handles the rice, chops the aromatics and blends the dressing so the final bowl still feels fresh and hand-tossed.
ingredients: 20 g neutral oil, plus extra for crisping
For the dressing: 25 g lime juice
15 g maple syrup or brown sugar
1 tsp chilli crisp or chilli oil, optional
steps: Place the rinsed rice, water and 20 g neutral oil in the mixing bowl. Cook 18 min / 100°C / Reverse / speed 1, then rest 5 min / 0°C / no speed with the lid on.

Spread the cooked rice on a lined tray and let it steam-dry for 10 minutes. Drizzle with a little extra oil, then bake in a preheated oven 18 min / 210°C oven / no speed until the edges are crisp and golden.
Place ginger and garlic in the mixing bowl and chop 4 sec / speed 7. Scrape down.
Add lime juice, soy sauce, sesame oil, maple syrup and chilli crisp. Mix 10 sec / 0°C / speed 4 until glossy.
Add cucumber, carrot, spring onion, coriander, mint and peanuts to a large serving bowl. Add the warm crispy rice, pour over the dressing and toss by hand just before serving.
tips: The rice crisps best when it has had a few minutes to steam-dry before baking.
Keep the herbs and dressing separate until the last minute so the salad stays bright and crunchy.
Add shredded roast chicken or tofu if you want it to be a bigger dinner bowl.

faq.q: Can I make crispy rice salad in a Thermomix?
faq.a: Yes. The Thermomix cooks the rice and blends the dressing; the oven gives the rice its crunchy texture.

faq.q: Can I make the rice ahead?
faq.a: Yes. Cook and chill the rice ahead, then crisp it in the oven just before serving.
